pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and irregular dark regions with moderate edge angularity. High-contrast, sharp-edged boundaries on the upper neck and dorsal ridge, transitioning to lower-contrast, diffused gradients on the mid-flank due to image blur and lighting.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lattice of light-colored pathways with tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, being most distinct in the upper-right quadrant and becoming indistinct in the lower-left due to overexposure and resolution limits.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Pronounced jagged 1D silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (~5-10 pixels in height relative to the base line).
